step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents RappiPay's microservices and compute infrastructure. End users access the application via CloudFront (protected by AWS WAF). Compute workload runs on Kubernetes via EKS using Spot Fleet (AutoScaling) and EC2 instances. Direct Connect connects the platform to partner systems. Developers manage the lifecycle of microservices and persistent layers (RDS, DocumentDB, ElastiCache, MSK) via a custom Microservices API layer.

graph.name: RappiPay Super App Platform Architecture
graph.notes: RappiPay architecture processes thousands of transactions per hour using EKS, Spot Fleet, and AWS managed databases.
